breakouts.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
breakouts.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

list.name: J.Blue
list.d: [[p:557711879|J.Blue]] jumped from 73 to 85 overall this offseason. Also: he saw his press coverage (67 to 82) and man coverage (78 to 92) take a big step in training. Plus, he slides into the starting lineup with D.Sanchez gone. Circle his name now.
